comment: The mirror button and the MIRROR trigger input are fed into one shared dsp::SchmittTrigger (simplex-oscillator.cpp:113-114), so a voltage held above 1V at that jack keeps the detector high and the button stops working until the jack falls again. The end-of-cycle output carries 11V rather than 10V as a private signal: simplex-oscillator.cpp:175 resets the on-panel display only when the sync voltage reaches 11V.
